732750301.text: ♪ ... Ah. It's you. Come, come. These flowers are growing well, are they not?

732750302.text: The Golden Roses have sprouted into seedlings, yes.

732750303.text: These seeds... Where did you even find these seeds, I wonder?

732750305.text: Did you indeed? Well, I suppose that the seeds Uncle Shafaqat sowed really did find their way back here in the end after being spread to every corner of the desert — even if the path they took meandered quite a bit.

732750307.text: We'll have to take good care of these seedlings — I intend to leave them to young Sabbah. Once I, too, am gone, these flowers shall pass on to her.

732750308.text: You've truly helped this old man out, and you asked for no reward — but ah, I would have trouble sleeping tonight if I didn't give you a little something at least.

732750309.text: This seedling recently broke through the soil, and Sabbah suggested giving it to you. She even wrapped it up nicely.

732750310.text: Take it as a memento from us. May you be as resilient as this seedling, and may you always keep the faith.
